Digital Realty Trust is a publicly traded real estate investment trust headquartered at 2323 Bryan Street, Suite 1800, Dallas, Texas, incorporated in Maryland, trading as DLR, SEC filer CIK 1297996.

As of December 31, 2025, the company reports 310 data centers worldwide, 221 wholly owned or consolidated and 89 held through unconsolidated joint ventures, totaling about 57.6 million rentable square feet, with roughly 9.7 million square feet under active development and 4.7 million held for future development. The portfolio spans more than 30 countries on six continents and more than 55 metro markets. Within the United States, the company reports 118 data centers, internationally it lists 113 facilities in Europe, 36 in Latin America, 18 in Asia, 16 in Africa, six in Australia, and three in Canada.

The registry here tracks 76 Digital Realty facilities across eleven states, Arizona, California, Connecticut, Georgia, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Oregon, Texas, Virginia, and Washington, a subset of the company's reported 118 US properties. Digital Realty operates as a colocation and wholesale landlord, leasing data center space and power to enterprise and cloud tenants rather than running its own compute at scale, the model that distinguishes it from hyperscaler operators such as AWS or Google that are also tracked in this registry.

The company maintains regional US offices in Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Los Angeles, New York, Northern Virginia, and San Francisco. Its own site separately states an Austin, Texas address as a company profile location, a discrepancy against the Dallas address filed with the SEC, this entry follows the SEC filing as the higher tier source.
